slide_copy: A coherent digital marketing strategy is no longer optional for local businesses.
Search visibility matters because most buying journeys begin with a search engine query.
Social proof compounds trust in a way advertising alone cannot buy.
Content consistency is rewarded by both algorithms and audiences over time.
Marketing activity is scattered and inconsistent rather than a repeatable system.
The reader adopts a structured, three-pillar approach to digital marketing.
